summary: Commit afe4944 fully closes the round-1 major finding (409/error hot-loop not verified). TestReviewListener: 10/10 pass. Full test_integration.py: 65/65. Full project suite: 1324/1324. All mutation experiments reverted; working tree diff-clean on news_bot.py and tests/test_integration.py.
